title: Konrad Zuse's calculating space and nuclear detonation test

tellings.quote: He theorized that it would be possible to test this in extremely high entropy events such as for example the detonation of a nuclear bomb.

plain: The German thinker Konrad Zuse, in his work Rechnender Raum, or Calculating Space, held that the universe works like a computation, and he thought this could be tested in extremely chaotic events such as a nuclear bomb going off. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells this without naming a source beyond Zuse himself, and writes about it on his online newsletter under the title Nuking the Matrix. If true, reality would be a kind of computer that could be caught glitching.
